about: NO3 allowlist ledger (architecture §18.3, plan rule 10, task M2.13): every mention of a port or upstream library in non-test src/, per file and library, with why it is there and the plan task that removes it. Checked by src/no_library_knowledge_tests.rs (cargo test --lib): a file may not gain a mention, and an entry must shrink with its file. M8.7 empties the ledger. Recorded 2026-09-27 at 24968659 (compiler source d1d48c4c): 30 mentions in 22 entries, all comments that justify a rule, a default or a schedule constant by one port's measurement. After merging batch A1 (e30cc68f): 31 mentions in 22 entries; A1 removed the katex import pin and added two citations (src/js/tables.rs, src/program/javascript_methods.rs).
